scenes.title: Who it is for
lines: Robots learn from human demonstrations, and the people who record them are rarely paid or credited. Thenar is for them: drive a robot arm from a browser, a Quest or a leader arm, and get paid on Monad for every run.

scenes.title: A lab posts a bounty
lines: The other side is a robotics lab. Its budget is a Privy server wallet whose policy only lets it fund Thenar. It posts a bounty on Monad, and when it's asked to send money anywhere else, Privy refuses to sign.

scenes.title: An operator signs in
lines: An operator signs in. Each onboarding step is read from the chain.

scenes.title: A passkey, verified on Monad
lines: A passkey makes them a person on chain. Monad's P-256 precompile verifies it through PasskeyRegistry.

scenes.title: Mera: the arm's key
lines: With Mera, the same passkey derives the key that commands their arm.

scenes.title: The lab's task, in the headset
notes: WEBXR · EMULATED HEADSET (IWER) · NOT A REAL QUEST
lines: Now the lab's task, in WebXR, with an emulated Quest standing in for the headset.

scenes.title: Drive it with your hands
notes: WEBXR · EMULATED HEADSET (IWER) · LIVE MONAD TESTNET
lines: Squeeze to take the arm, and it follows the controller millimetre for millimetre. Grip the payload, carry it over, and set it in the ring.

scenes.title: Scored, signed, paid
lines: Submit. The verifier scores the samples and signs, and one transaction records the run and pays the operator.

scenes.title: Executed, then final
lines: {TIMERS} The receipt shows every step: seen by the node, executed, then final, checked against the finalized tag.

scenes.title: The operator owns a share
lines: And the operator now owns shares of this corpus.

scenes.title: The data
lines: The run is now data, built from the samples its hash commits to.

scenes.title: An agent buys it over x402
lines: An AI agent buys it over x402: one cent of USDC, settled on Monad. Then it checks the file against the sale logged on chain.

scenes.title: Every sale, in public
lines: The terms, and every sale, are public.

scenes.title: Chainlink CRE audits the corpus
lines: Chainlink CRE then audits the corpus. It rebuilds each task's Merkle root from the served episodes, reads what's committed on Monad, and writes a verdict per task on chain.

scenes.title: CRE's verdict: uncommitted
lines: Its verdict: uncommitted. The episodes are served, but no root is committed yet, and CRE says so on chain, beside the data.

scenes.title: Who earned, who bought
lines: Operators ranked by what they earned, agents by what they bought.

scenes.title: Monad, read live
lines: And the network page reads Monad and Ethereum side by side, live. Thenar: people teach robots, own the data, and get paid on Monad.

card.head: Thenar
card.sub: Drive a robot. Own the data. Get paid on Monad.
